# goovm: a fast -O0 LLVM back-end written twice (C++ reference, Goose port).
#
#   cmake -G Ninja -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
#   ninja -C build -j2
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(goovm C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
if (NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif ()

option(GOOVM_WITH_GOOSE "Link the Goose back-end (goose-generated cg.c) into goovm-llc" OFF)
set(GOOVM_GOOSE_C "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/backend-goose/build/cg.c" CACHE FILEPATH
    "C file generated by: goose --standalone --header cg.h -o cg.c backend-goose/cg.goose")
set(GOOVM_GOOSE_H "" CACHE FILEPATH "Header generated with it (default: cg.h next to GOOVM_GOOSE_C)")

# LLVMConfigVersion.cmake only accepts exact major.minor requests, so ask
# for any version and check the major one.
find_package(LLVM REQUIRED CONFIG)
if (NOT LLVM_VERSION_MAJOR EQUAL 20)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "goovm needs LLVM 20 (found ${LLVM_PACKAGE_VERSION} in ${LLVM_DIR}); "
            "pass -DLLVM_DIR=/usr/lib/llvm-20/lib/cmake/llvm")
endif ()
message(STATUS "goovm: LLVM ${LLVM_PACKAGE_VERSION} from ${LLVM_DIR}")

add_subdirectory(backend-cpp)
add_subdirectory(tools/goovm-llc)
